svg.title: Side pickups — timing
svg.desc: Top-down layout diagrams appear above the matching timelines. Four-item belt stacks · sixteen-item hand · Factorio 2.1.21 · legendary stack inserter Each green dot is a four-item stack pickup; the hand contains sixteen items after the fourth dot. All rows share a tick axis starting at the first grab. Total ticks include the first and last grab.

Normal moving side-entrance first hand: the game takes 5 ticks; the current model predicts 4. Other limits are in the matrix.
Collection only: excludes waiting before the first grab, travel to/from the destination and the drop. Measured examples, not universal constants.
